name: horse-upper
frame: placements are on the 2048x2048 reference canvas

placements.name: saddle
placements.note: complete 339x240 no-white-edge saddle (ma-maan-wanzheng.png), no baked notch and no trim. Reference fit enlarged 1.0414x from the first 2.1281 fit, anchored at the saddle's brown bottom-left, then nudged +8px forward (x 546.2 -> 554.2): the front edge meets the mane's inner line at its end (both x=1299 on the 2048 canvas). The horn highlight moves with it to ma (697.9,534.9), 7.2px right of ma-cankao's (690.7,534.7). The saddle is drawn ABOVE the neck; its complete right panel intentionally covers the neck's end corner, the only intended difference from ma-cankao. Layer: above the neck, below the head.

placements.name: neck
placements.note: new neck with trimmed mane glued on; 1:1 copy of Desktop\道具素材\1-matou_副本.png; drawn larger than ma-cankao (not a pixel copy), registered to the reference neck cutout by silhouette. Drawn directly over the body: the old reference backing and sampled seam fill were removed on 2026-10-23, so no old-neck piece remains.

placements.name: head
placements.note: ma-cankao fit (eye and nostril). The 6px drop from the banded assembly is NOT applied: it compensated for the old separate mane band, which this neck piece replaces.

seam.method: neck-body gap filled from the nearest body colours; the thin saddle-edge strip is backed with the new neck's own edge colours, below the saddle top (no old-neck pixels)

saddleLayer.note: complete saddle covers the neck's end corner; no RGB sampling at the connection

upper.note: body + saddle + new neck; 1:1 with the 2048 canvas, cropped to the union bbox plus 2px

bust.note: body + saddle + new neck + head; same frame as upper, plus the head
